final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price FROM rating_stats), above_mean AS (SELECT rs.avg_length, rs.per_day_price, o.mean_per_day_price FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rs.per_day_price > o.mean_per_day_price) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS average_of_average_lengths, AVG(per_day_price) AS average_per_day_price, AVG(per_day_price - mean_per_day_price) AS average_excess_per_day_price FROM above_mean
